page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 959 GB SSD. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers weak single-core and multi-core performance, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, it achieves average performance in the Passmark CPU score and extended instructions tests. Memory performance is mixed; while read-only memory bandwidth is weak, large block write bandwidth registers in the average tier. Cryptographic and compression tasks show limitations, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%.

The server presents a tradeoff between its substantial 959 GB local SSD storage capacity and its modest processing capabilities. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks fall into the bottom 25%, indicating that high-throughput transactional workloads may face bottlenecks. The server is suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, or lightweight local storage-dependent applications that do not require high-frequency CPU performance or intensive memory bandwidth.
